{{Top|leg}}
'''Drone duracrete tankers''' were large transport vehicles used to move loads of liquid [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]]. One was used in an offensive capacity in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Team Purella]] during their effort to capture [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Aidel Saxan]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
